title: How the Wealthy Beat Inflation

scenes.text: Why do billionaires keep buying assets that outpace 3 % inflation?
They allocate at least 30 % of net worth to real estate, which historically rises faster than CPI.
scenes.label: 30% REAL ESTATE
scenes.query: real estate returns vs inflation data

scenes.text: Another 20 % goes into dividend‑paying stocks that have delivered 7‑10 % annual total returns.
scenes.label: DIVIDEND STOCKS

scenes.text: The remaining 50 % stays in cash‑equivalent vehicles that earn at least the Fed’s interest rate, protecting liquidity.
scenes.label: LIQUID CASH
